identification: Four pieces of unmarked early 20th century blue-to-orange gradient pottery with desert scenes: a tall two-handled vase and a small two-handled vase (both with camel riders, palm trees), and two jugs with a mosque and camel scene. Probably English or Japanese/Czech transfer-and-hand-painted 1920s-30s ware. Damage seen: chip on foot of the small vase, a repaired crack/glue lines through one handle and body of the small vase, small chip on rim of the tall vase.
marks_seen: No maker's marks seen in any photo (no base photos). Photos show damage close-ups only.
google_searches: Searched desert scene / camel vase wordings on Terapeak to identify comparable ware; no maker could be established without base marks.
